競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: レンディングツリー
companies.sub: ローン・保険の比較サイト

relations.text: LendingTreeの2025年の売上の27%が、提携先のProgressive Casualty Insurance向け
relations.text_en: Progressive Casualty Insurance, a network partner, made up 27% of LendingTree's 2025 revenue

source.label: LendingTree 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, one Network Partner, Progressive Casualty Insurance, accounted for 27% of total consolidated revenue, all of which was recorded within our Insurance segment.

relations.text: TWFGの2025年の売上の11%がProgressive向け(保険の代理販売)
relations.text_en: Progressive made up 11% of TWFG's 2025 revenue (policies sold as its agency)

source.label: TWFG 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, The Progressive Corporation accounted for 11% and 13% of our total revenues, respectively.

companies.name: セレクトクォート
companies.sub: 保険の販売(オンライン)

relations.text: SelectQuoteが自動車・住宅保険で扱う保険会社の一社にProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: SelectQuote lists Progressive among the carriers it sells for in auto and home

source.label: SelectQuote 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Safeco, Progressive, and Travelers in Auto & Home.

companies.name: バークシャー・ハサウェイ(GEICO)

relations.text: Berkshire傘下のGEICOが、自動車保険の競合としてProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: Berkshire's GEICO names Progressive among its auto insurance competitors

source.label: Berkshire Hathaway 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: GEICO competes for private passenger automobile insurance customers in the preferred, standard and non-standard risk markets with other companies that sell directly to the customer and with companies that use agency sales forces, including State Farm, Progressive, Allstate and USAA.

companies.name: ルート
companies.sub: 自動車保険(テレマティクス)

relations.text: Rootが10-Kで、競合の大手全国保険会社としてProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: Root names Progressive among the large national insurers it competes with

source.label: Root 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include large national insurance companies such as GEICO, Progressive and Allstate

relations.text: Lemonadeが10-Kで、自動車保険の競合としてProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: Lemonade names Progressive among its car insurance competitors

source.label: Lemonade 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Competitors in the car insurance space include companies such as Progressive, GEICO and Allstate.

companies.name: セーフティ・インシュアランス
companies.sub: 自動車保険(マサチューセッツ)

relations.text: Safety Insuranceが10-Kで、マサチューセッツ州の自動車保険の主な競合としてProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: Safety Insurance names Progressive among its main Massachusetts auto insurance competitors

source.label: Safety Insurance 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors in the Massachusetts commercial automobile insurance market are MAPFRE SA, Arbella Mutual Insurance Company and Progressive Casualty Insurance Company

relations.text: Horace Mannが10-Kで、自動車保険の競合としてProgressiveを挙げる
relations.text_en: Horace Mann names Progressive among its auto insurance competitors

source.label: Horace Mann 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete for auto business with other companies such as GEICO, Progressive and USAA, many of which feature direct marketing distribution.
